# THORACIC SURGERY (INCLUDES SECTION ON ESOPHAGEAL PROCEDURES)

# Esophageal Surgical Procedures:

# Prophylaxis:

Cefazolin weight based dosing Preop + Metronidazole 500mg IV ONCE Preop
beginning 60 minutes before incision

Prophylaxis recommendations includes BOTH MEDICATIONS q8h for 2 doses post-op.

Please place post-op antimicrobial prophylaxis orders after admission.

*Local guidance (Omaha CDSS, Inpatient/Outpatient):*
[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# Thoracic surgery (except for esophageal procedures):

Includes video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) and non-cardiac procedures, including lobectomy, pneumonectomy, lung resection and thoracotomy.

# No post-operative doses are recommended.

# Prophylaxis

[Cefazolin Weight Based Dosing Preop R](surg-cefazolin-weight-based-dosing)

# References

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 Vol 70 page 195-283
- Antimicrobial Prophylaxis for Surgery, Treatment Guidelines from The Medical
- Letter 2012 Vol 10 pages 73-77
